name: What are the biggest mistakes in luxury custom home planning?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause the most problems in luxury custom home projects?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause the most problems in luxury custom home projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common luxury custom home mistakes happen before construction really begins. Owners often fall in love with a design before confirming what the site can support or what the budget can comfortably absorb. Other frequent problems include delaying permit work, ignoring long-lead materials, making finish decisions too late, and selecting a builder who lacks experience with similar homes or local conditions. In Los Angeles, those mistakes can be especially costly because hillside sites, tight lots, and permitting complexity leave less room for error. The best way to avoid problems is to align the design, budget, site review, and construction strategy early. Homeowners should also ask for realistic contingency planning and a clear approval process for changes. Good planning does not remove every risk, but it reduces the chance that the project will be forced into expensive compromises later.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are starting design without a realistic budget, underestimating site conditions, delaying permit planning, choosing finishes too late, and hiring a builder without similar local experience. These errors often lead to cost overruns, delays, and design compromises.
